name: aob-productivity
description: Alchemy of Breath team productivity mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: northstar
plugins.description: Your North Star above the prompt in every Claude Code session: purpose, organisation, and week/month/quarter/year/5-year focus. /northstar init|stop|start. Optional live row.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: A kanban pane beside the chat that lists your open Monday.com tasks (read-only, through your own Monday connector) and, if you keep one, a personal Day/Week board. /kanban init|refresh|status.
